sources.title: Gryte, Hann, Alam, Rohac, Johansen, Fossen (2018) Aerodynamic modeling of the Skywalker X8 Fixed-Wing UAV, ICUAS 2018
sources.supports: Wind-tunnel (VZLU) static coefficients and XFLR5 stability derivatives (Table V); test matrix; CG 440 mm; b 2.1 m, c 0.357 m; HS-5085MG servos; CG-sensitivity discussion

sources.title: Reinhardt, Gryte, Johansen (2022) Modeling of the Skywalker X8 Fixed-Wing UAV: Flight Tests and System Identification, ICUAS 2022
sources.supports: Re-identified tunnel model (Table I), lever arm, bifilar inertia matrix, Fitzpatrick propeller parameters, STLSQ damping model. DOI suffix differs from repo README (9836114); verify

sources.title: Low-Hansen, Hann, Johansen, Deiler (2024) Time-Domain System Identification and Validation of Small Fixed-Wing UAV Dynamics (AIAA)
sources.supports: Mass/inertia/geometry Table 1, elevon mapping eq.14, flight-identified coefficients Table 6, propulsion Tables 3-4, actuator model Table 7, NTNU hardware (Hacker A40-12S, Jeti SPIN Pro 66, Aeronaut CAM 14x8)

sources.title: Low-Hansen, Hann, Gryte, Johansen, Deiler (2025) Modeling and identification of a small fixed-wing UAV using estimated aerodynamic angles, CEAS Aeronautical Journal (CC BY 4.0)

sources.title: Gryte (2015) High Angle of Attack Landing of an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle, MSc thesis, NTNU
sources.supports: 3-D-scan chord/LE table E.1 (planform, elevon stations), measured component masses Table 6.2, CG Table 6.1, rough inertia Table 6.3, XFLR5+tuned coefficients Table 6.4, flat-plate stall blend (M, alpha0, Cm_fp), servo limits (-30/+35 deg), Hacker A40-12S and Zippy 4S data Tables H.1-H.2, winglet modelled at 76.5 deg dihedral. Licence: Norwegian copyright act (open access)

sources.title: Gryte (2020) Precision control of fixed-wing UAV and robust navigation in GNSS-denied environments, PhD thesis, NTNU
sources.supports: Bifilar-pendulum inertia Table 6.1 (Ixx 0.335, Iyy 0.140, Izz 0.40, Ixz -0.029), added-mass discussion, ~3.5 kg takeoff weight, 18 m/s cruise, net/belly landing context. Licence: Norwegian copyright act (open access)
